issues.quote: up 1 2 3 percent from $60.9 billion in fiscal 2024
issues.problem: The growth rate is garbled and wrong. Going from $60.9B to $130.5B is an increase of about 114%, not 123%.

data.summary: The figures for revenue ($130.5B), prior-year revenue ($60.9B), net income ($72.9B), operating income ($81.5B), total assets ($111.6B) and cash and cash equivalents (about $8.6B) all match NVIDIA's fiscal 2025 results. The growth rate is wrong: it reads "1 2 3 percent", but the actual increase was about 114%.
